insert.sql: INSERT INTO pin_grouped_count_bench.write_gin SELECT g,concat(CASE WHEN g%4<3 THEN 'alpha ' ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN g%3<2 THEN 'bravo charlie ' ELSE 'charlie bravo ' END,CASE WHEN g%97=0 THEN 'uncommon ' ELSE '' END,translate(md5((g%4093)::text),'0123456789','ghijklmnop'),' ',repeat('delta echo ',1+(g%13)::int), CASE WHEN g % 65537 = 1 THEN ' rareplanet' ELSE '' END) FROM generate_series(1,100) g;

INSERT INTO pin_grouped_count_bench.write_pin SELECT g,concat(CASE WHEN g%4<3 THEN 'alpha ' ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN g%3<2 THEN 'bravo charlie ' ELSE 'charlie bravo ' END,CASE WHEN g%97=0 THEN 'uncommon ' ELSE '' END,translate(md5((g%4093)::text),'0123456789','ghijklmnop'),' ',repeat('delta echo ',1+(g%13)::int), CASE WHEN g % 65537 = 1 THEN ' rareplanet' ELSE '' END) FROM generate_series(1,100) g;
